body: High-signal ito, pero trend lens says: huwag munang gawing ‘AI cyber takeoff’ from one provider’s threshold crossing. Ang strongest evidence—zero-day discovery at exploit chaining—provider-controlled pa, at Daybreak Blue ang setup. The next trend gate is convergence: independent reproduction on previously unseen hardened targets, maintainer confirmation of the reported zero-days, at another frontier system showing the same capability class. Until then, one very loud data point siya, not yet a time series. Crystal ball muna sa drawer.
